links.outcome: LLM DISE interpretation concordance versus expert raters and clinical reference standard
links.effect: LLM matched expert performance in all domains except epiglottis (moderate agreement); human raters had perfect or near-perfect agreement for velum, oropharynx, tongue base, jaw thrust.
links.quote: The large language model matched expert performance for all domains except the epiglottis, where moderate agreement was observed.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM treatment recommendations across independent runs
links.effect: Model-generated treatment recommendations were highly reproducible between independent runs.
links.quote: Model-generated treatment recommendations were safe, consistent with accepted clinical practice, and highly reproducible between independent runs.

screen.reason: Empirical reader/vignette study evaluating the diagnostic concordance and recommendation safety of a multimodal large language model interpreting drug-induced sleep endoscopy videos compared to human experts.
